name: ShopWired Payments
author: ShopWired Payments

sections.description:
Accept payments on WooCommerce with ShopWired Payments

ShopWired Payments makes it simple to accept secure debit and credit card payments on your WooCommerce store, with competitive transaction fees and no ongoing monthly charges.

Whether you’re launching a new store or looking for an alternative to your existing payment provider, ShopWired Payments offers straightforward pricing, a convenient checkout experience and an easy way to get started.

Explore the demo store

See how ShopWired Payments fits into a WooCommerce checkout. Visit our demo store.

Simple, transparent pricing

Accept card payments with straightforward transaction fees:

  • UK consumer cards: 0.80% + 15p per transaction
  • All other cards: 1.60% + 15p per transaction
  • No monthly fees
  • No minimum processing commitment
  • No contract

Learn more about ShopWired Payments

Why choose ShopWired Payments?

A convenient checkout experience

Give your customers a straightforward way to pay for their orders using debit or credit cards.

Choose between two checkout experiences:

  • Embedded checkout: Customers enter their payment details through a secure payment form within your WooCommerce checkout.
  • Hosted checkout: Customers are redirected to a secure ShopWired Payments payment page to complete their purchase.

Both options allow you to accept payments without handling sensitive card information directly.

Works with your WooCommerce checkout

ShopWired Payments supports both traditional WooCommerce checkout pages and the newer WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

You can use the plugin with either checkout experience without needing to change how your store is built.

Easy account connection

Connecting your WooCommerce store to ShopWired Payments is straightforward.

There’s no need to manually generate, copy or configure API keys. Simply install the plugin and follow the connection process to link your ShopWired Payments account.

Secure payment processing

Customer card details are entered into a secure payment form hosted by ShopWired Payments.

The plugin does not collect or store customers’ card details. Payment information is processed through ShopWired Payments, and payment status is communicated back to WooCommerce.

Features at a glance

  • Accept one-off debit and credit card payments
  • Competitive transaction-based pricing
  • Secure embedded checkout
  • Secure hosted checkout option
  • Compatible with classic WooCommerce checkout
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks
  • Simple account connection without manual API keys
  • Payment status communicated to WooCommerce
  • No advertising or usage telemetry within the plugin

Please note: ShopWired Payments currently supports one-off payments only. Subscriptions and recurring payments are not supported.

External services and data sharing

This plugin connects to ShopWired Payments, an external payment processing service, to enable merchants to accept payments through WooCommerce.

The plugin communicates with:

https://swpcore.shopwired.io

When you connect your ShopWired Payments account, the plugin shares the website and connection information necessary to establish and maintain that connection. This includes the site’s HTTPS URL, callback and event URLs, a one-time site proof and the permissions requested.

When a customer reaches checkout, the plugin may send order and customer information to ShopWired Payments to prepare a payment session. This can happen before the customer enters or submits their payment details.

This information can include the order reference, amount, currency, purchased products, tax and shipping costs, and the customer’s name, billing address, email address and telephone number.

When a payment is submitted, the plugin exchanges the information necessary to process the transaction. It also authenticates requests using installation credentials and receives or retrieves payment status information so WooCommerce can update orders appropriately.

Customer card details are entered into a ShopWired Payments-hosted payment form and are not collected or stored by the plugin. The hosted form may load payment-processor software or redirect to a payment provider to complete the transaction.

Simply installing or activating the plugin does not send information to ShopWired Payments.

The plugin does not include advertising or usage telemetry. Its own JavaScript and CSS are bundled as readable source, and it has no private auto-updater.

For further information, please see:

  • ShopWired Payments Terms
  • ShopWired Payments Privacy Policy

Upgrading from earlier private versions

If your old plugin uses the shopwiredpay-for-woocommerce directory, deactivate it before activating this shopwired-payments package. Never activate both copies. Keep the default preserve-data setting and back up before updating. Saved settings, encrypted connections, payment records and return links are preserved during the storage-prefix migration. If data conflicts or cannot be migrated, payment processing pauses with an admin notice; retry the update or contact support. Do not downgrade after migration. Previously cancelled orders are not automatically reopened.

Data and uninstall

Encrypted installation credentials, one-off payment-session records and payment-event identifiers are stored locally. Deactivation stops plugin-side scheduled work but preserves connection and payment data. Uninstall also preserves data by default.

Data deletion is opt-in through the Uninstall data setting in WooCommerce > ShopWired Payments. If enabled, uninstall permanently removes the plugin’s one-off payment-session records, shared event-receipt table, settings, pending connection state and encrypted credentials. Back up and reconcile orders first. WooCommerce financial records are not deleted by this plugin.

Historical recurring-payment tables from older versions are retained, even during opt-in deletion. The plugin does not operate or cancel existing subscriptions or other Core-managed collections. Do not upgrade a store with active ShopWiredPay subscriptions until they have been migrated or cancelled and reconciled. Uninstall never makes remote payment or cancellation changes.

The plugin adds suggested disclosure text to WordPress’s Privacy Policy Guide. Store owners remain responsible for their privacy notice and the legal basis for sharing customer and order data.

Trademarks

ShopWired and ShopWiredPay are marks of their respective owners. WooCommerce and WordPress are marks of their respective owners. This plugin’s use of those names describes compatibility and does not transfer ownership of any mark.
sections.installation:
Getting started with ShopWired Payments takes just a few steps. WooCommerce 11.0 or later must be installed and active.

  1. Install and activate the ShopWired Payments plugin on your WordPress website.
  2. Open WooCommerce > ShopWired Payments.
  3. Follow the connection process to link your ShopWired Payments account.
  4. Choose your preferred checkout experience.
  5. Enable ShopWired Payments as a payment method.

You’ll need a ShopWired Payments account to accept payments.

Create a ShopWired Payments account
sections.faq:
Do I need a ShopWired Payments account?

Yes. You’ll need an account to process payments. You can create a ShopWired Payments account.

How much does ShopWired Payments cost?

UK consumer card transactions are charged at 0.80% + 15p. All other card transactions are charged at 1.60% + 15p. There are no monthly fees, no minimum processing commitment and no contract.

Will customers leave my website to pay?

That depends on your checkout settings. You can display the secure payment form directly within your WooCommerce checkout or redirect customers to a hosted payment page.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes. Both classic WooCommerce checkout and Checkout Blocks are supported.

Do I need to configure API keys?

No. The plugin provides an account connection process that does not require manually copying API keys.

Does the plugin store customers’ card details?

No. Card details are entered into a secure payment form hosted by ShopWired Payments. The plugin does not collect or store card details.

Can I accept subscription payments?

No. The plugin currently supports one-off payments only. Recurring payments and subscriptions are not supported.

Does installing the plugin automatically send information to ShopWired Payments?

No. Simply installing and activating the plugin does not send information to ShopWired Payments. Information is exchanged when you connect your account or when the plugin prepares or processes payments.

Where can I get help?

Visit ShopWired Payments support.

Report suspected security vulnerabilities privately through support, not in a public forum. Include the plugin version and reproduction steps, but never passwords, card data or live credentials.
